label: A · 5%-below put
variant_note: Cheap-protection window always buys the ~5%-below put.
rules: Fake $1,000 in QQQ from day one. Once per trading day (post-close): cheap-protection window → buy the ~5%-below put, notional-matched; spreads-or-collars → open the 5→15 put spread; trim → sell 25% of shares, once per episode; GREEN → put cash back into QQQ. Options marked at chain mids, settled at intrinsic on expiry. Benchmark: the same shares, never touched.
